product_one_liner.value: voize is an AI voice-documentation app that turns caregivers’ spoken notes into structured electronic health-record entries for long-term care and skilled nursing facilities.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains licensing by the number of people receiving care rather than by user accounts.

named_customers.notes: AGAPLESION is described as using voize in production; Newcare Gruppe appears in a customer testimonial.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator lists a team size of 140.

hq_location.notes: voize's press page identifies Berlin as its headquarters; its Y Combinator profile also lists Berlin, Germany.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering team's blog includes “Teaching Prometheus and OpenTelemetry-collector to be friends” by Reuben Morais and “PyTorch Lite Multiplatform” by Erik Ziegler.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple documentation collections, including 75 articles for residential elder care.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A Senior ML Engineer – NLP posting has an active application link.

model_provider.notes: The Senior ML Engineer – NLP posting says voize uses Claude through its inference service, alongside open and on-device models.

compliance_certs.notes: These are public compliance claims. The FAQ explicitly says voize itself is not yet ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certified.

last_funding.notes: The $50 million Series A, led by Balderton Capital, was announced on November 17, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The $50 million Series A announcement is dated November 17, 2025, within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive – US posting has an active application link.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 22, 2026, voize and Dedalus announced an ORBIS integration that captures bedside speech and transfers structured nursing information directly into ORBIS U.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The cited profile records a September 2026 start as VP Engineering at voize.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Growth Marketing Manager posting requires HubSpot knowledge covering workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, nurture programs, segmentation and reporting.
